loop_primitives.evidence_quote: the reasoning module will reevaluate the action using the execution feedback
loop_primitives.note: Per-step CoT decide -> execute -> verifier feedback, plus periodic reflection every n steps.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: every 𝑛 step, the agent evaluates the𝑛 most recent actions and environ-mental observations to devise a new game strategy
planning_granularity.note: Strategy is free-text reflection stored in memory; not a structured plan object.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: we randomly assign 30 agents with profiles based on the representing cluster’s size
multi_agent_topology.note: Multiple agents interact as equals via public/private chat in a simulation; each agent is otherwise single.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: Public Chatting, enables players to send messages visible to all players

long_term_memory.note: LTM with numeric embeddings is within a simulation run; cross-run persistence not stated.
